corrected_code:
import socketio
from typing import Dict, Any

sio = socketio.AsyncServer(async_mode="asgi", cors_allowed_origins="*")

@sio.on("join_workspace", namespace="/collaboration")
async def handle_join_workspace(sid: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    session = await sio.get_session(sid, namespace="/collaboration")
    if not session or "user_id" not in session:
        await sio.emit("error", {"detail": "Unauthenticated socket session"}, room=sid, namespace="/collaboration")
        return

    workspace_id = data.get("workspace_id")
    if not workspace_id:
        await sio.emit("error", {"detail": "workspace_id required"}, room=sid, namespace="/collaboration")
        return

    membership_service = sio.environ[sid]["app.membership_service"]
    if not await membership_service.is_member(session["user_id"], workspace_id):
        await sio.emit("forbidden", {"detail": "User is not a member of this workspace"}, room=sid, namespace="/collaboration")
        return

    await sio.enter_room(sid, workspace_id, namespace="/collaboration")
    await sio.emit("joined", {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "sid": sid}, room=sid, namespace="/collaboration")
